data.notes: The report's strongest point is that it challenges the rep's 'decided before we got in the room / nothing to do' with the coverage facts: no business review for 9–10 months, a new owner we never met, discovery only via the renewal split, and an analysis that arrived three weeks late. It also ties 'What's mine?' to replacing the average-uplift messaging. It misses some of the key's points: 'Approval rates' appears only as the runner-up behind 'Value proof'; the decider section never concludes the decision was made before we engaged; and no messaging change answers 'local acquiring'. The close leaves out the win-back and protect-the-US follow-up, wrongly labels the answered 'reaction/silence' question as dodged, and overrides the rep's statement that the uplift number got silence.
